description: This file declares functions and structures related to handling output files, specifically for sparse or compressed data. It provides function prototypes for opening, writing to, and closing output files, as well as reading data from file descriptors.

methods.name: output_file_open_fd
methods.description: Open an output file with specific parameters.

methods.name: output_file_open_callback
methods.description: Open an output file with a custom write callback.

methods.name: write_data_chunk
methods.description: Write a data chunk to the output file.

methods.name: write_fill_chunk
methods.description: Write a fill pattern chunk to the output file.

methods.name: write_file_chunk
methods.description: Write a chunk from a file to the output file.

methods.name: write_fd_chunk
methods.description: Write a chunk from a file descriptor to the output file.

methods.name: write_skip_chunk
methods.description: Write a skip chunk (no data, just length) to the output file.

methods.name: output_file_close
methods.description: Close the output file and free resources.

methods.name: read_all
methods.description: Read all data from a file descriptor into a buffer.
